description: AI standard operating procedure writer — Turn rough notes or a process description into a structured Standard Operating Procedure: title, purpose, scope, roles, prerequisites, materials, numbered one-action steps with owner/details/checkpoint, warnings, quality checks, records to keep, KPIs and open questions (unknowns are listed, not invented), plus offline quality flags (steps without owners or verbs, no checkpoints) and a ready-to-paste Markdown version. Params: process= (required, up to 8000 chars), audience=, organization=, compliance= (e.g. HACCP, ISO 9001), max_steps= (3-25, default 12). Llama 3.3 70B via Workers AI. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
